# Orbit

> There’s more to live beyond the usual. Orbit isn’t open yet; people can join the waitlist at https://heyorbit.in.

## What Orbit will have

- Fests in one click: register for a fest in one go.
- Turf, courts and gaming by the hour: book a slot at a turf, a court or a gaming café.
- Hackathons with teams and results: teams, rounds, announcements and results in one place.
- inRoom at meetups: see who else is at the meetup you’re at.
- Comedians and bands you love: follow performers and tap “Loved it” after the show.
- Hosting: hosts run their events, tickets and check-in on Orbit.

## The waitlist

- Join at https://heyorbit.in with a name, a WhatsApp number (confirmed with a 6-digit WhatsApp code), an email address and a date of birth. Orbit is for people 18 and over.
- Joining is free and is not an account. Orbit will say when it opens.
